title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Sale Finality and Withdrawal of a Pending Return
content:
**When the sale becomes final.** A sale under Vehicle Purchase Agreements becomes final on the first day after the return window ends, when the order is delivered with no return pending. The order moves to completed with the closure reason sale final, and the 7-day right is gone.

**Withdrawing a return.** A buyer may withdraw a pending return at any time before handing the vehicle back. Withdrawal is the buyer's own act. The order returns to delivered, the return request is marked withdrawn, and the withdrawal uses up the order's one return request, so a second return request on the same order is not accepted. A withdrawn return does not extend the window.

**A return still pending at the end of the window.** An order that is return pending when the window ends is not finalized while the return is pending.

**Questions the terms answer.**

*The return window of an order ended on day 7 and the order is delivered with nothing pending. When is the sale final?* On day 8, the first day after the window ends; the order then shows completed with the closure reason sale final.

*A buyer signed a return on day 3 and withdrew it on day 5, before handing the vehicle back. Can the buyer start another return on day 6?* No. The withdrawal used up the order's one return request.

*Does withdrawing on day 5 give the buyer a fresh window?* No. A withdrawn return does not extend the window.

*An order is still return pending at the end of its window. Does it complete on the next day?* No. It is not finalized while the return is pending.
